info.title: v2.product.search_item
info.description: Use this call to search item.

get.description: Use this call to search item.

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: The token for API access, using to identify your permission to the api. Valid for multiple use and expires in 4 hours.

parameters.name: attribute_status
parameters.description: 1:get item lack of requires attribute. 2:get item lack of optional attribute.

parameters.name: deboost_only
parameters.description: If deboost_only is true, then API will return items whose deboost is true, if deboost_only is empty or false, then API will return items whose deboost is true and false simultaneously

parameters.name: item_sku
parameters.description: sku. If you search for item_sku and item_name at the same time, only the results that match item_sku will be returned. If you search for item_sku and attribute_status at the same time, the results that match both item_sku and attribute_status will be returned.

parameters.name: item_status
parameters.description: NORMAL/BANNED/UNLIST/REVIEWING/SELLER_DELETE/SHOPEE_DELETE If you want to search multiple status, please upload the url like this: item_status=NORMAL&item_status=BANNED

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Specifies the starting entry of data to return in the current call. Default is empty. if data is more than one page, the offset can be some entry to start next call.

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Partner ID is assigned upon registration is successful. Required for all requests.

parameters.name: shop_id
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for a shop. Required param for most APIs.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by partner_id, api path, timestamp, access_token, shop_id and partner_key via HMAC-SHA256 hashing algorithm. More details: https://open.shopee.com/documents?module=87&type=2&id=58&version=2

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: This is to indicate the timestamp of the request. Required for all requests. Expires in 5 minutes.

200.description: Response documented by Shopee Open Platform.

<?php

$curl = curl_init();

curl_setopt_array($curl, array(
  CURLOPT_URL => 'https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/product/search_item?access_token=access_token&attribute_status=2&item_name=apple&offset=0&page_size=10&partner_id=partner_id&shop_id=shop_id&sign=sign&timestamp=timestamp',
  CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
  CURLOPT_ENCODING => '',
  CURLOPT_MAXREDIRS => 10,
  CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 0,
  CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION => true,
  CURLOPT_HTTP_VERSION => CURL_HTTP_VERSION_1_1,
  CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => 'GET',
  CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => array(
    'Content-Type: application/json'
  ),
));

$response = curl_exec($curl);

curl_close($curl);
echo $response;
